audit.whatIsWrong: The entire content layer describes the PRE-REWORK Aurelion Sol. It names 'Starsurge', 'Center of the Universe' and 'his orbiting body damage' — none of which exist in his kit. His real abilities are Cosmic Creator (P), Breath of Light (Q), Astral Flight (W), Singularity (E) and Falling Star / The Skies Descend (R). The page never named a single one of them.
audit.why: The kit file is authority on names and the packet's own defect list flags exactly this: 'never names any of Aurelion Sol's abilities'. Every piece of advice built on the old orbit-and-Starsurge pattern is advice for a champion that is not in the game.
audit.corrected: spikes[0-3], early, mid, late, whys[0], all three wants.you and all three wants.foe rewritten onto the real kit: Breath of Light as a 3s channel, Singularity as a 12s black hole with a percent-health execute at its centre, Astral Flight as the 22s escape, Falling Star as a 120s stun.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four rows disagreed between layers: full read Skill at Level 1, Skill at 4-5, Skill at first item and Aurelion Sol at 2+ items, while content read Akali on all seven.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is all Akali and the matchup runs 52.69% over 818 games. Aurelion Sol has one mobility tool on a 22s cooldown and one hard-CC ability on 120s; Akali has an 825-range flip, a reset and an untargetable window. There is no stage where he takes the lane back.
audit.corrected: Four full-layer rows flipped to Akali so the chart reads Akali across, matching content and packet.

audit.whatIsWrong: The spike table had no real timings — level 6 was described as 'his ultimate flings him across the map', which conflates Falling Star with Astral Flight, and the late spike credited 'passive orbit speed'.
audit.why: Falling Star is the 120s, 1250-range stun; Astral Flight is the 22s traversal. Cosmic Creator grants Stardust that permanently improves his abilities — that, not orbit speed, is his scaling.
audit.corrected: Spikes rewritten around Singularity at 3-5, Falling Star at 6, Stardust scaling for the item spike, and Astral Flight as the only late escape.

audit.whatIsWrong: No numbers anywhere; the cooldown block said only 'he is a stationary battery while it is down'.
audit.why: Astral Flight 22/20.5/19/17.5/16, Singularity flat 12s, Falling Star 120/110/100, Breath of Light flat 3s. The 22s Astral Flight is the real green light.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t, breakdown.carry and the wants lines.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization implied resistances answer his damage.
audit.why: Singularity is flagged percentHealth and executes below a health percentage at its centre — stacking MR does not move that threshold.

notes: This matchup's content layer was written for the pre-rework Aurelion Sol end to end — Starsurge, Center of the Universe, orbiting body damage. Worth checking whether other Aurelion Sol matchups across the lane carry the same stale text; it is likely a shared source, not a one-off. The full layer's tldr/winCon/dosFull/dontsFull reference only 'Astral Flight' and are correct as far as they go, but read templated; I grounded the ones I could and left tradeGood/tradeBad/ahead/breakdown.wave, which give nothing Aurelion-Sol-specific to work with.
